jobs.title: Junior Backend Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Lumen Ledger is hiring a Junior Backend Engineer (100% remote, EMEA / South Asia).

Lumen Ledger makes reconciliation and month-end close software for small finance teams: accountants at companies of 20 to 200 people who no longer want to match bank lines in spreadsheets. The team is 34 people, fully remote, and this is their second junior backend hire.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Node.js/TypeScript services that import bank feeds and match transactions to invoices
  • Write PostgreSQL migrations and tune the queries behind the matching engine
  • Ship small, well-tested changes several times a week, reviewed by a senior engineer
  • Take part in a daytime-only support rotation after onboarding

Requirements

  • 1+ year of professional backend experience with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Comfortable with SQL and relational data modelling (PostgreSQL preferred)
  • Clear written English for async collaboration
  • 4+ hours of overlap with 09:00-17:00 CET

Nice to have: Docker / Docker Compose, some AWS (RDS, ECS, Lambda), interest in accounting or payments.

Salary: USD 28k-36k per year, paid monthly via an employer of record, plus a USD 600 learning budget and home-office stipend.

jobs.title: Junior Developer - Work From Home ($4,000/week)
jobs.description:

Payment

All salaries are paid weekly in USDT (crypto) to your wallet for fast international payment. Bonus paid in Bitcoin for top performers. Limited positions available, apply today before the slots are filled!

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all countries. No interview needed, you will be hired on the same day after the registration fee is received.
